commenti.body: Is this a serious question? How would you describe the whole era from the mid-60s to the early 80s, also commonly known as New Hollywood? I mean, It is without doubt one of the most defining periods in American Film history.

Besides New Hollywood also being called New American Cinema, Wikipedia also defines a [New American Cinema](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_American_Cinema) as the avant-garde movement involving directors such as, oops a Canadian, like Michael Snow, but also Americans like Hollis Frampton and Ken Jacobs.
